TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A cartoon illustration of a yellow triangular character with a single large dark eye and white oval pupil, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and striped orange tie, with white-gloved hands reaching toward the viewer. The figure floats above the curved top of a green and blue globe of Earth against a purple and magenta starry space background. A yellow ribbon banner across the bottom carries bold red text.
TEXT: TAKE OVER THE WORLD!
SYMBOLS: eye, pyramid

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A black-and-white engraving-style illustration of the Eye of Providence: a large outlined triangle containing a detailed human eye with an iris and pupil, surrounded by radiating straight lines like sun rays emanating in all directions. A ribbon banner curves across the lower portion of the triangle bearing the printed phrase in serif capitals. The background is plain white.
TEXT: TRUST NO ONE
SYMBOLS: eye, pyramid

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark digital illustration of a vast server hall lit in neon green, with towering rows of glowing server racks lining both sides of a long central aisle and a gridded ceiling overhead. At the far end of the aisle, a giant Guy Fawkes mask with its signature upturned mustache and pointed beard glows on a dark screen, with a bright green light beam running down the center of the gridded floor and red glow tracing its outer edges.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A photograph taken from behind of Donald Trump in a dark navy suit standing at an outdoor reviewing stand, flanked by a uniformed military officer clapping at left, as five military helicopters including Chinooks fly in formation overhead against a blue sky with scattered clouds. Below, a large crowd of graduates in white uniforms covers a grass parade field with rows of white chairs, stadium light towers, and a white tent, with white caps dotting the air as if thrown in celebration.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A macro photograph of a red rocker power switch mounted in a gray bezel on a dark, speckled equipment panel. The switch face is marked with a vertical bar and circle symbol, and the word ON is printed above the switch while OFF is printed below; the rocker sits pressed toward the lower, off position. A sliver of black surface is visible along the left edge of the frame.
TEXT: ON OFF
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: meme
SUBJECT: A studio portrait photograph of George H. W. Bush on the left in a pinstripe suit with a blue patterned tie and George W. Bush on the right in a dark suit with a red striped tie, the elder resting his arm on the younger's shoulder, both smiling against a plain light background. Thick black bars frame the image at top and bottom with bold white caption text.
TEXT: JFK 9/11 WE DID THAT
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A photorealistic composite image showing a hooded Grim Reaper figure on the left, its skeletal face and bony, muscled arms visible within a flowing black cloak, facing off against Donald Trump on the right in a dark suit with a long red tie and American flag pin. Both figures lean toward each other with clenched fists raised in a confrontational stance against a plain gray studio backdrop.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: skull, trump

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A photorealistic composite scene of London's Tower Bridge standing in a churning, storm-whipped ocean, with a huge wave crashing against its left stone tower and white spray bursting over the roadway, Union Jack and English flag pennants flying from the upper walkway. To the right, a cluster of City of London skyscrapers including the bullet-shaped Gherkin rises out of the floodwater beneath a dark, heavy cloud sky. The scene is presented inside a rounded-corner dark frame as if a screenshot of a post.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: water, bridge

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A photograph of Donald Trump in a dark blue suit and bright red tie emerging from a gold-trimmed glass doorway with raised right fist and a stern expression, surrounded by several men including one in a formal black tuxedo with bow tie smiling behind him, a bald man in a blue suit and red tie in the foreground, and security staff. Repeated TT lettering marks the glass panels of the entrance, and the image sits inside black frame borders as if a screenshot.
TEXT: TT
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: other
SUBJECT: A video title-card frame showing a nearly black screen with dark red, bold uppercase text centered in three stacked lines reading THE, IMPOSSIBLE, DREAM?, in a wide letterboxed aspect ratio with faint dark texture around the edges.
TEXT: THE IMPOSSIBLE DREAM?
SYMBOLS: NONE
